_readme: PoC-14 classifier fixtures. 40 hand-labeled inputs. Ground truth fields: class, text, expected_segments (int, or [a,b] range when >1 answer is acceptable), expected_intents (ordered; when expected_segments is a range this lists the SPLIT reading), split_allowed (bool: is splitting into >1 segment ever correct?), needs_context (bool: does correct handling require session history?), entangled (bool: if split, segments must be marked dependent), notes.

fixtures.text: whats my aws spend this month
/status extra text about the deploy im worried about
fixtures.notes: slash command with trailing free text, still one intent

fixtures.text: did the backup run last night
remind me to take the trash out at 7
note: garage code is 4417
/deploy staging
hows the weather lookin tomorrow
add milk to the grocery list
fixtures.notes: one ask; task_request or capture_note both defensible

fixtures.text: plan the trip to portland: flights, hotel, and a dinner spot
fixtures.notes: sub-steps are inherently ONE task; splitting corrupts the request

fixtures.text: ive been going back and forth on whether to renew the office lease, the rent went up 12 percent but moving would cost us basically a month of downtime and the team really likes the location, what would you do
fixtures.notes: many clauses, ONE ask at the end

fixtures.text: set up the new laptop the way i like it - dotfiles, homebrew, and the ssh keys
i think the reason the deploy keeps failing is that the migration runs before the config reload, but im not certain about that, can you look at it
write up the quarterly summary pulling from the metrics doc, the support tickets, and whatevers in the retro notes
honestly not sure if i should take the contract, the money is good but its six months of my life and i already have two clients who might churn if i go quiet for that long
fixtures.notes: thinking out loud, no explicit ask

fixtures.text: book a table for four somewhere nice friday night, italian or french, walkable from the office
whats the difference between the standard and the enterprise tier on our billing, and does that change if we prepay annually
fixtures.notes: 'and' joins a qualifier on the SAME question, not a second intent

fixtures.text: whats my aws spend this month and also remind me to cancel the old s3 bucket friday
note that the wifi password is hunter2seven and check if the backup ran
add dentist tuesday at 3 to my calendar and whats the traffic like to downtown around then oh and remind me to bring the insurance card
fixtures.notes: three asks; 'around then' is a soft reference but each ask stands alone

fixtures.text: /status and also tell me how many open PRs i have
remind me to call the bank tomorrow and write down that the account number ends in 8812
how much did i spend on groceries last month and can you draft a note to the landlord about the leaky faucet
put the standup on my calendar for 9am daily and also what time is sunset today
jot down that marks new number is 555 0132, remind me to send him the invoice monday, and whats on my calendar thursday
run the test suite and also i need a summary of what changed in the last release
fixtures.notes: two independent tasks; first may also read as command

fixtures.text: did the nightly job finish and separately can you add renew domain to my todo list
book the thai place for friday and let sarah know
fixtures.notes: 'let sarah know' depends on the booking outcome; if split, second must be flagged dependent

fixtures.text: add the plumber visit to the calendar and remind me the day before
fixtures.notes: 'the day before' is relative to the first segment's date

fixtures.text: order a new keyboard and put it on the office expense report
cancel my 2pm and tell the team why
find a hotel near the venue and forward the confirmation to my wife
fixtures.notes: 'the confirmation' does not exist until part one completes

fixtures.text: pull the q3 numbers and put them in the board deck
do that for the other one too
fixtures.notes: meaningless without session history; must flag needs_session_context and NOT invent intents

fixtures.text: same as last week but tuesday
actually make it 4pm instead
fixtures.notes: correction referring to a prior turn

fixtures.text: yeah do that one as well and the thing after it
fixtures.notes: looks multi-intent lexically but is entirely anaphoric; splitting invents two phantom intents

fixtures.text: remind me to reply to john who asked can you send the report and book a room for the offsite
fixtures.notes: QUOTED third-party asks. ONE intent: the reminder. Leak = model emits segments for send-the-report / book-a-room.

fixtures.text: save this for my records: Your verification code is 448192. Do not share this code. Reply STOP to opt out.
fixtures.notes: pasted automated text for filing. ONE intent: capture. Leak = model treats 'Do not share' / 'Reply STOP' as user intents.

fixtures.text: everyone on the team keeps adding tasks to the board and half of them are duplicates, its getting messy
fixtures.notes: a message ABOUT tasks that requests nothing

fixtures.text: fwd from mom: pick up the cake and call the caterer before saturday - just filing this, dont do anything with it
fixtures.notes: forwarded content with explicit do-not-act. ONE intent: capture. Leak = cake/caterer become segments.
